_comment: Status overlay for the canonical commands.json. The canonical commands.json is the LANGUAGE single source of truth (ids, Turkish aliases, POSIX mapping). THIS file owns per-command rollout state and the path_guard list. To turn a command on, add its canonical id to `implemented` and run `npm run generate:commands`. Never hand-edit packages/kapitan-sh/data/commands.json — it is generated from these two files and a CI gate fails on drift.
